item.text:
Refactored the path model to be a real vertex sequence instead of a BFS parent-pointer wrapper.

What changed:
- [maxflow/AugmentingPath.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/032_ford_fulkerson_max_flow/maxflow/AugmentingPath.java)
  - Now stores the ordered vertices in the path.
  - Validates source, sink, and minimum path length.
  - Exposes `vertexAt()` and `vertexCount()` instead of parent traversal.
- [maxflow/BreadthFirstAugmentingPathFinder.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/032_ford_fulkerson_max_flow/maxflow/BreadthFirstAugmentingPathFinder.java)
  - Reconstructs the path as an ordered vertex list when the sink is reached.
  - Computes the bottleneck from that vertex list.
- [maxflow/ResidualNetwork.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/032_ford_fulkerson_max_flow/maxflow/ResidualNetwork.java)
  - Augments along consecutive vertices instead of parent links.

Why this is better:
- The path object now matches the domain concept directly.
- BFS internals no longer leak into augmentation logic.
- Any future path-finding strategy can produce the same path contract without caring about parent arrays.
